title: Taskflow Agent and CodeQL find code injection in PraisonAI GitHub Actions
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent and CodeQL
summary: The reusable issue-triage action interpolated attacker-controlled issue bodies and titles into shell assignments in a workflow with access to an Anthropic API key, creating privileged code-execution and secret-exposure risk.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits both CodeQL and its Taskflow Agent with discovery; Peter Stöckli verified and reported the issue. The source does not apportion discovery between the two tools.
classification_note: The public GHSL report describes the code-injection flaw and remediation; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the issue was fixed in a commit on 2025-12-16; the advisory does not identify a tagged release or establish whether downstream copies were updated.
